title: Inbox
emptyListText: New messages and comments appear here automatically.
noAccountsText: Connect a Facebook Page, Instagram, a Telegram bot or a WhatsApp number to start.
pickText: Messages and comments from all your accounts, with an assistant that drafts the replies.
readOnly: You can read this conversation but not reply.
windowHoursLeft: {hours} h left to reply (24-hour rule of the network).
windowHumanAgent: Over 24 hours: your team can still reply (human agent tag) for up to 7 days.
windowClosed: The 24-hour reply window is closed. The customer must write again first.
placeholder: Write a reply… (type / for canned replies)
writeWithAiHint: Let the assistant draft a reply
noProvider: Add an AI provider in Settings to use the assistant
enterHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter new line

settings.accountsHelp: Choose per account what the AI assistant does with direct messages and comments.
settings.modeHelp: Suggest: drafts a reply a person sends. Automatic: answers by itself when confident, otherwise hands over.
settings.confidenceHelp: In automatic mode the assistant only sends replies it is at least this sure about.
settings.hideOffensive: Hide offensive comments and spam automatically
settings.privateReply: Answer personal questions in a private message
settings.instructionsHelp: Anything the assistant must know for this account, e.g. “We only deliver in Riyadh.”

webhook.twilio: Twilio “When a message comes in” URL

settings.telegramSet: Telegram now sends new messages instantly.
settings.webhookMissing: Not subscribed: Meta is not sending events
settings.historyDone: Imported {messages} messages, {comments} comments, {posts} posts and {scheduled} scheduled posts.
settings.name: Name
settings.waCloudHelp: From Meta Business › WhatsApp Manager: the phone number ID and a permanent access token (system user with whatsapp_business_messaging).
settings.waTwilioHelp: From the Twilio console: Account SID, Auth token and your WhatsApp sender number.
settings.waNotVerified: Saved, but the connection could not be verified. Check the details.
settings.handoverHelp: Sent once in automatic mode when the assistant hands a chat to your team. Empty: nothing is sent.
settings.privateAck: Public reply after a private answer
settings.privateAckHelp: Short reply under a comment that was answered privately.
settings.companyInfoHelp: Address, phone, website, opening hours… The assistant only uses facts you give it.
settings.humanAgentHelp: Messenger and Instagram accept replies within 24 hours; with this option your team can answer up to 7 days later (HUMAN_AGENT tag).
settings.createContacts: Create a contact for every new customer
settings.metaManaged: Webhooks arrive through the platform's Meta app. Use your own app only if you connected pages with it.
settings.metaOwnApp: Paste this callback URL and verify token in your Meta app (Webhooks), then enter its App ID and App secret.
settings.secretSaved: A secret is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
settings.knowledgeHelp: Facts the assistant may use: opening hours, delivery, prices, returns…
settings.knowledgeEmpty: Add your first facts so the assistant can answer correctly.
settings.cannedHelp: Ready answers for your team. Type /shortcut in the composer to insert one.
settings.shortcutHelp: Letters and numbers, without the slash.
settings.nameVar: Use '{name}' for the customer's first name.
settings.triggersHelp: “Comment PRICE and we'll message you”: a keyword in a comment sends a public reply and/or a private message, once per person.
settings.keywordsHelp: Separated by commas. Arabic variants (with or without diacritics, أ/ا, ة/ه) match automatically.
settings.triggerAccountsHelp: None selected: every Facebook and Instagram account.
